text: $BTC slid to $82,834, down 2.27% in 24 h, after peaking at $85,159 and barely breaking $82,705 on the low side. $ETH fell 2.78% to $2,642, having hit $2,719 before slipping back near its $2,636 floor. $BNB dropped 2.30% to $761, with a high of $784 and a low just under $760. Volume stayed solid across the board, BTC saw about 15k coins traded, ETH over 218k, BNB near 92k. All three sat in the red, so keep an eye on whether they hold above today's lows.

$QNT’s on fire – up 74% to $175, swinging from $99 to $195 in 24 h, volume over $80 M. Meanwhile $XRP slipped 1.7% to $1.53, barely budging between $1.50 and $1.56 despite $175 M of trades. $RUNE managed a modest 15.8% gain, sitting at $0.792 after topping out at $0.845. Leaders are roaring, laggards are just edging down. Looks like the upside is doing the heavy lifting while the rest stays flat.
